subject: Executive health flags + action commitments (monthly)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: James Sullivan <j.sullivan@acme-corp.com>, procurement@atlascloud.com
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Executive health flags + action commitments — Aug monthly

Team,

Attached is the August monthly KPI packet (monthly_kpi_dashboard_aug2027.pdf) and the raw incident log (incident_log_20270820.csv). High-level bullets for the leadership readout and QBR prep: 

- Latency: 95th latency increased ~18% WoW on the small-batch (<=64 tokens) path. Initial signal points to increased tail times on the attention kernel when KV-cache misses occur (see dashboard p.4).
- Cost: token-level unit cost up ~12% MoM primarily because smart-routing fell back to the higher-capacity GPU pool for several hours during the driver rollback on Aug 20. Estimated incremental cost: ~$24k this month.
- Uptime: service uptime for the month sits at 99.95% after a ~12-minute degraded window on Aug 20 during the GPU driver rollback; incident log attached. No customer data was impacted.
- Usage: a rapid adoption wave from Acme (onboarding cohort) drove a short-term burst in small, low-latency calls which exacerbated tail latency. James (cc'd) — can you confirm this aligns with their expected onboarding activity?

Immediate asks / owners (please treat as commitments for the QBR):
1) Laura — root-cause and mitigation proposal for the small-batch latency tail by Tue, 24 Aug EOD. If KV cache churn is confirmed, propose a config toggle + safe canary.
2) Evelyn — recommend whether SLOs need a temporary exception for Aug and language for the QBR slide (due Wed, 25 Aug).
3) Vivek — assess commercial impact and propose a customer-facing credit or burn-down plan; target recommendation by Thu, 26 Aug.
4) James / Acme — please share any internal timing or traffic expectations; if the burst is ongoing, confirm so we can prioritize routing changes.

I'll compile updates and produce the exec slide (short readout) on Wed morning for the Friday QBR.

Attachments: monthly_kpi_dashboard_aug2027.pdf (summary), incident_log_20270820.csv (raw), signed_sow_acme.pdf (for finance awareness).

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
VP, Customer Reliability & Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 09:02:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive health flags + action commitments — Aug monthly

Irene — thanks for the head's up and the packet. Quick read: I see the same tail on p.4/5. I'll run a prioritized triage first thing and aim to have a mitigation plan by Tue EOD. Early hypotheses:
- KV cache eviction due to short-lived multi-tenant bursts (we saw similar pattern in Apr).
- A regression in the attention kernel under a particular sequence length mix.

Plan: reproduce locally with live traces, validate cache eviction thresholds, test a config that pins a larger KV cache for the routing policy used by Acme's cohort. If that looks promising, I'll propose a safe canary (10% traffic) + rollback criteria.

On timeline: Tue 24 Aug EOD deliverable — mitigation + canary plan. Will add measured expected latency delta and estimated incremental cost.

Onward —
Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference

Folks — consolidating commitments and next steps for the QBR (final slide deck due Fri morning):

Action commitments (owner — due):
- Laura Bennett — mitigation proposal for small-batch 95th tail + canary plan — DUE Tue, 2027-08-24 EOD. (Deliverable: one-page plan + expected latency delta + test matrix)
- Evelyn Hart — SLO recommendation + QBR wording for the temporary exception (if any) — DUE Wed, 2027-08-25 noon.
- Vivek Kulkarni — customer impact assessment + credit recommendation (range + precedent) — DUE Thu, 2027-08-26 EOD.
- James Sullivan / Acme — export of onboarding cohort call volumes or confirmation the ramp continues — DUE Thu, 2027-08-26 EOD.
- Legal / Procurement — standing by for any contract language or DocuSign follow-ups on credit agreements (cc'd).

Immediate risks noted: cost delta if routing remains on fallback pool; reputational risk for Acme if latency persists during onboarding; minor probability of repeat short outages while we validate driver roll-forward.

I will own the QBR slide and will circulate a draft Wed 25 Aug morning for quick review. If anyone wants an addendum on technical detail, we will add a second backup slide with traces and reproductions.

Attachments included: monthly_kpi_dashboard_aug2027.pdf (updated with a one-page exec summary), incident_log_20270820.csv, signed_sow_acme.pdf (for finance visibility).

Thanks for moving quickly on owners.
